correctness.rationale: The submitted endpoint ratio and quartic stabilization are correct but an ancillary published-prefactor quotation in the original RESULT.md and VERIFICATION.md was false: 2^q/(nQ) instead of the source’s 2q/(nQ). The replacement full RESULT.md and VERIFICATION.md correct this and derive the claim independently. Direct integration gives integral_{R_t}|y|^2 dy=(8/3)(1-t^4), so Vtilde_4=16(1-t^4)/3 and deficit =t^4/4+O(t^8). For d=n-2, the exact box moment is Vtilde_{n+2}(K)=(n+2)(2epsilon)^d/n *[(8/3)(1-t^4)+(4d/3)epsilon^2(1-t^2)]; hence the exact finite-thickness ratio is [1-t^4+(d/2)epsilon^2(1-t^2)]/[1+(d/2)epsilon^2]. Its epsilon-down-to-zero limit proves the stated all-dimensional (n+2)-root deficit. The subtle distinction is that fixed positive thickness d>0 adds a quadratic term, so quartic is the limiting law only. The repair changes no original SLOGAN and claims no universal stability theorem.
